title: HFA-ICOS initial Cardio-Oncology risque évaluation pour Combination Rapidly Accelerated Fibrosarcoma (RAF) et Mitogen-Activated Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase (MEK) Inhibitors
formula:
The HFA-ICOS Cardiotoxicity Risk (RAF-MEKInhibitors) is defined by the number and severity of risk factors.
Patients with no risk factors or one **Medium** point are classified as low risk, those with two to four **Medium** points as medium risk, those with five or more **Medium** points or any **High** factor as high risk, and those with any **Very high** factor as very high risk.

| Variable | Factor |
| --- | --- |
| Previous Cardiovascular Disease | |
| Heart failure or cardiomyopathy | Very high |
| Myocardial infarction or CABG | High |
| Stable angina | High |
| Severe valvular heart disease | High |
| Borderline LVEF 50-54% | Medium (2 points) |
| Arrhythmia 1 | Medium (1 points) |
| Cardiac Biomarkers | |
| Elevated baseline troponin 2 | Medium (2 points) |
| Elevated baseline BNP or NT-proBNP 2 | Medium (2 points) |
| Demographic and Cardiovascular Risk Factors | |
| Age ≥65 years | Medium (1 points) |
| Hypertension 3 | Medium (2 points) |
| Diabetes mellitus 4 | Medium (1 points) |
| Chronic kidney disease 5 | Medium (1 points) |
| Previous Cardiotoxic Cancer Treatment | |
| Prior anthracycline exposure 6 | High |
| Prior radiotherapy to left chest or mediastinum | Medium (2 points) |
| Lifestyle Risk Factors | |
| Current smoker or significant smoking history | Medium (1 points) |
| Obesity ( [BMI](nabda:calc.body-mass-index-bmi-body-surface-area-bsa\) >30 kg/m 2 ) | Medium (1 points) |

^1^Atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, ventricular tachycardia, or ventricular fibrillation.
^2^Elevated above the upper limit of normal for local laboratory reference range.
^3^Systolic blood pressure (BP) >140 mm Hg or diastolic BP >90 mm Hg, or on treatment.
^4^HbA1c >7.0% or >53 mmol/mol or on treatment.
^5^Estimated glomerular filtration rate <60 mL/min/1.73m^2^.
^6^Previous malignancy.

how_to_use.why:
- Recommended in the[2022 ESC Cardio-Oncology Guidelines](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36017568/)for baseline cardiovascular risk stratification in patients scheduled for RAF and/or MEK inhibitor therapy.
- Enables risk-adapted monitoring and management.
how_to_use.when:
- Utiliser avant que les patients adultes en oncologie commencent un traitement par inhibiteur de RAF et/ou de MEK afin de stratifier le risque initial de complications cardiovasculaires liées au traitement.
- Réaliser rapidement lors des décisions thérapeutiques oncologiques afin d’éviter des retards inutiles dans le traitement.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed by the Heart Failure Association (HFA) of the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) and the International Cardio-Oncology Society (ICOS) to stratify baseline cardiovascular risk in cancer patients prior to potentially cardiotoxic therapies.
- Derived from expert consensus and systematic literature review.
- Estimates risk for all cardiovascular complications associated with the specific drug class; for RAF and MEK inhibitors, the main complications include hypertension, left-ventricular dysfunction/cardiomyopathy, heart failure, and QTc prolongation (notably with cobimetinib plus vemurafenib).
- Relies on clinical risk factors (modifiable and non-modifiable); does not account for genetic/epigenetic risk, and may underestimate risk in some low-risk patients.

next_steps.advice: Cet outil est une aide à la décision et doit être utilisé conjointement avec le jugement du clinicien, les préférences du patient, l’expertise du spécialiste et les recommandations actuelles fondées sur les données probantes/les protocoles locaux ; les résultats ne doivent pas être le seul déterminant de la prise en charge.
next_steps.critical_actions: A referral to cardiology should be obtained for any patient who develops cardiotoxicity during therapy, regardless of initial risk.
next_steps.management:
- **Low risk:** Continue treatment with appropriate cardiovascular surveillance.
- **Medium risk:**

 - Provide closer monitoring of cardiovascular health.
 - Manage cardiovascular risk factors.
 - Consider cardio-oncology or cardiology referral.
- **High and very high risk:**

 - Discuss risks and benefits of proposed chemotherapy.
 - Initiate closer cardiac monitoring.
 - Refer for cardio-oncology or cardiology assessment to optimise risk factors and provide a personalised management plan.
- For more detailed guidance, please refer to the[2022 ESC guidelines](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36017568/).

instructions:
This tool is specifically for evaluating cardiotoxicity risk ofRAF and MEK inhibitortherapies.

Other HFA-ICOS cardiotoxicity risk assessments are available for the following therapies:

- [Anthracyclines](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-anthracycline-chemotherapy) .
- [HER2-targeted therapies](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-her2-targeted-therapies) .
- [VEGF inhibitors](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-vegf-inhibitors) .
- [Multi-targeted kinase inhibitors for CML](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-multi-targeted-kinase-inhibitors-chronic-myeloid-leukaemia-cml) .
- [Multiple myeloma therapies](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-multiple-myeloma-therapies) .
